meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用网址、设计稿或文字素材生成动画视频和动效画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把现成素材快速做成宣传片或动效视频,又不想从零搭流程。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a URL, design file, or brief into animated videos and motion graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn existing assets into promo or motion videos without setup.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 碰到视频、动画、动效类需求会先读这个技能:判断项目状态、恢复已有进度或先问清主题,再选定对应工作流,最终产出 HyperFrames 的 HTML 合成。
howto.when: 当你提出制作、编辑、渲染视频或动画等需求,或要处理已有的 HyperFrames 项目时接管;若请求没说明主题或素材,它会先问视频讲什么再分流。

say.text: 帮我做一个 30 秒的产品宣传视频
say.note: 会先问清主题,再路由到对应工作流

say.text: 把这个 GitHub PR 讲成一段视频
检查一下我现有的 HyperFrames 项目
say.note: 只执行该操作,跳过意图问答

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads this skill first for any video, animation, or motion graphic request: it checks project state, resumes existing progress or asks what the video is about, picks the matching workflow, and outputs a HyperFrames HTML composition.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, or to work on an existing HyperFrames project. If the subject or input is missing, it asks what the video is about before routing.

say_en.text: Make me a 30-second product promo video
say_en.note: It asks about the subject, then routes

say_en.text: Turn this GitHub PR into a video

say_en.note: Runs only that operation, skips the interview
